oracles.tool: aws-cdk-lib aws_iam PolicyDocument.fromJson and PolicyStatement.fromJson (AWS) + jsonc-parser for lines

notes: aws-cdk-lib's action grammar is stricter than IAM's: it refuses 8 AWS managed policy versions on tenchi-security/camp that IAM itself published (an action with a space, amplifybackend: * and lambda:ListFunctions with a trailing space; an action with a hyphen, config:select-resource-config); the 8 documents and statements stay in the measured set, so fathom's 16 definitions and 45 references there count against it; every other entity agrees with parliament 1.6.4 (38,553 of 38,569 definitions and 543,829 of 546,159 references, the rest exactly the refused statements), which the same wave relabels C to B (design §1.5 D2: a widely used third-party parser's dump) and keeps as the cross-check

definitions and references at tier A (wave ox, LB-Q-aws-iam-policy-rest; relabelled from C with the reason in calibration/oracles/parliament/README.md, design §1.3 "the format's reference parser": IAM's own parser is online only, and aws-cdk-lib's aws_iam is AWS's first-party offline policy model): a document is an entity when PolicyDocument.fromJson accepts it (or, written with one Statement object, which IAM accepts and fromJson refuses, when PolicyStatement.fromJson accepts the statement: 27 camp documents), a statement when PolicyStatement.fromJson does, its references the parsed statement's elements; lines from jsonc-parser, an independent reader
no measured subject is YAML (neither oracle reads YAML), so the YAML form is covered by a golden and the dispatch tests only; L3 (the policy_ref emission, LB-F139) is not measured here
per-file times exclude the one-time grammar compile (an untimed warm-up extraction precedes timing)
